description: Four-knob voltage sequencer with two outputs that walk the knobs in opposite directions, and a binary divider of the same clock

params.text: Sets the voltage one step sends, 0V to 5V; the knob serves the X count and the Y count at the two step numbers printed beside it

inputs.text: Moves both counts and the divider on each rise above 1V
Runs both counts the other way round the four knobs while the voltage here is above 1V

outputs.text: A gate that changes state on every clock, so it is at 5V for one clock and 0V for the next
A gate at 5V for two clocks and 0V for the next two
A gate at 5V for four clocks and 0V for the next four
A gate at 5V for eight clocks and 0V for the next eight
The voltage of the knob the X count has reached, 0V to 5V
The voltage of the knob the Y count has reached, 0V to 5V; Y takes whichever knob X does not, reading the four in the opposite order

notes: one clock input drives the sequence and the divider together; with nothing patched there, X gives the first knob's voltage, Y the last, and the divider outputs stay at 0V.

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
